snippet.title: Coup de Koala Trailer v2
snippet.description:
This is the second edition of my trailer for my game Coup de Koala.

Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala monarch, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850090/Coup_de_Koala/
itch.io: https://vliu09.itch.io/coup-de-koala
